text: APPROVE: the extracted helpers keep the original expressions, short-circuit order and trimming (including the untrimmed `IsSigningKeyValue(value)` call), so behaviour is unchanged, and removing the nested ternary, the seven-way `||` gate and the lambda-heavy checks plausibly takes the complexity from 28 to 15 or below. I could not build or measure anything here, so two things are unconfirmed: that `lines` is a `string[]` and that none of the new helper names collide with others in the partial class.
